chosen_titles.rationale: California's Government Code houses Title 9 (Political Reform Act), Ch. 6 (Lobbyists, §§ 86100 et seq.), which is the state's lobbying-disclosure statute body.

notes: CA 2015 vintage is hosted on Justia. Single-title pick: lobbying disclosure under the Political Reform Act lives entirely in the Government Code; no parallel executive-branch lobbying regime in a separate title.
